findings.summary: Clicking the app voice test while its focused-control guidance is holding playback discards the saved playing state, leaving the lecture paused after the test.
findings.fix: Preserve the currently held playback intent when replacing control guidance with the explicit test, then resume only with unchanged view/lesson/fence. Do not force play when initially paused.
findings.evidence: 실제 확장·MP4 재생 상태에서 재현: 보류 중인 초점 안내를 음성 시험으로 교체한 뒤 paused_after_test=true. supplement/observations.json voice_test_resume.

findings.summary: Playback failures and learning-view ownership loss stop the lecture but update only ARIA text, bypassing built-in app speech for students without an external screen reader.
findings.fix: Route important connection-loss and lease-loss messages through a mode-aware announcement helper: app TTS when enabled, persistent ARIA in reader mode, deduplicated to avoid polling spam. Preserve ordinary silent progress updates.
findings.evidence: 실제 영상 탭 종료 및 다른 확장 화면의 재생 lease 취득에서 영상은 멈추고 connection 텍스트는 바뀌었으나 앱 합성 호출과 sullivan-status 이벤트는 모두 비어 있음. runtime-live/observations.json.

findings.summary: Login focuses the workspace before applying the account’s external-reader preference, allowing app TTS to start under the previous default mode.
findings.fix: Apply student mode before the authenticated focus move, or suppress/cancel initial guidance until account preferences have been applied. Retain the user-navigation guard for delayed restoration.
findings.evidence: 기기별 override를 제거하고 서버 reader_mode=true로 새 확장 문서를 열면 최종 모드는 reader이나 speechSynthesis 호출에 내 강의 1회가 기록됨. runtime-live/observations.json.

findings.summary: Built-in guidance names numeric speed, volume and pitch fields without their current values and does not announce arrow-key changes, so app-only users cannot verify adjustments.
findings.fix: Include nonsensitive numeric setting values and units in control guidance and announce committed or debounced changes for these specific fields. Continue excluding password, account and free-text values.
findings.evidence: 실제 확장에서 영상 음량을 0.4로 바꿔도 합성 요청은 영상 음량 (0~1)만 포함하고 0.4는 포함하지 않음. supplement/observations.json numeric_value_guidance.

findings.summary: A failed guardian preview question leaves its result status saying the answer is still being checked even after the global error is announced.
findings.fix: When the request fails, replace the pending preview status with a terminal failure for the same preparation, or clear it before forwarding the error. Guard against replacing a newer selection’s status.
findings.evidence: 실제 키 미설정 API의 503 이후 global_error는 표시되나 preview-answer는 준비 자료의 근거로 답변을 확인하고 있습니다에 남음. runtime-live/observations.json.

passed: Freshly reread current source instead of reusing prior clean reports.
Natural Korean voice selection, pronunciation normalization, sentence chunking, style/edge prosody and cancellable breath delays are implemented.
Narration cancellation generation and media fence protect normal stale completion and prior-state resume paths.
Connected guidance and external-reader focus now pause playback; no-lesson guidance remains available.
Home command entry and onboarding are reachable before selecting a lesson.
Guardian terminal job transitions and connection failures use persistent deduplicated status channels.
Ordinary reader answers avoid duplicating full response through two narration channels.
notes: 원본 소스 재검토 후 부모 에이전트가 실제 임시 Chromium 확장 문서에서 다섯 항목 모두를 재현했다. 음성은 호출 기록용 시험 장치이며 실제 사람이 듣는 음성·OS 스크린리더 실행을 주장하지 않는다.
runtime-live의 최초 환경 오류 및 runtime-keyboard의 최초 CSP 검사 도구 오류는 제품 오류로 세지 않았다. 수정한 감사 스크립트로 새 임시 프로필에서 재실행했다.
